Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count number;
 e_lock EXCEPTION;
 PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(e_lock, -00054);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select b.min_temp, b.max_temp
 into temp_min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'CB' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 qc_date is null and
 exists (select 'x'
 from units
 where batch_id = b.batch_id
 and nvl(qc_checkin_flag, 'X') != 'Y'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 for update of batch_id nowait;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN e_lock then
 show_error('0292');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into :s_unit_count
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 --and nvl(qc_checkin_flag, '') != 'Y';
--qc_checkin_date is null
 if :s_unit_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into :s_count_no_trns
 from temp_units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into :s_count_no_bags
 from units
 where chapter_id =:GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 batch_id is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_local_time date;
begin
 :units.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:units.unit_id,null,null);
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/10/2011. Enable timezone to BLEED_START_TIME
 if is_timezone_enabled and :units.bleed_start_time is not null and 
 to_char(:units.bleed_start_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_start_time, t_local_time);
 :units.d_bleed_start_time := t_local_time;
 else
 :units.d_bleed_start_time := :units.bleed_start_time;
 end if;
 
 t_local_time := null;
 if is_timezone_enabled and :units.bleed_end_time is not null and 
 to_char(:units.bleed_end_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') != '00:00:00' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units.bleed_end_time, t_local_time);
 :units.d_bleed_end_time := t_local_time;
 else
 :units.d_bleed_end_time := :units.bleed_end_time;
 end if;
 -- End of change
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BATCH_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT b.batch_id, b.checkin_user_id,
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, b.insert_dats) insert_dats
 FROM batch_inputs b
 WHERE b.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, insert_dats) 
 BETWEEN TRUNC(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE))-21 
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE)
 AND SUBSTR(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'CB'
 AND qc_date IS NULL
 AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 'x'
 FROM units
 WHERE batch_id = b.batch_id
 AND NVL(qc_checkin_flag, 'X') != 'Y'
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 )
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
 ORDER BY insert_dats DESC

Trigger.Name: DO_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 close_batch varchar2(1) := 'Y';
begin
 if :perform_commit = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('units');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag in ('Y','N')
 then
 
 :qc_checkin_date := sysdate;
 
 if :units.coll_date is null or
 -- :bag_code is null or SCR: 152021
 :donor_decision_code is null or
 :drive_id is null or
 :group_site_id is null or
 :bleed_start_time is null or
 :bleed_end_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :units.unit_id, :units.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'DATA',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions DATA not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :units.coll_date is not null
 then
 if trunc(:bag_checkin_dats) < trunc(:units.coll_date)
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :units.unit_id, :units.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'CBDT',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions CBDT not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :max_temp > 37.5
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :units.unit_id, :units.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'TEMP',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions TEMP not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 if :qc_checkin_flag is not null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :units.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :units.coll_date;
 show_error('0225');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 close_batch := 'N';
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if close_batch = 'Y' then
 
 update batch_inputs
 set qc_date = sysdate
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 qc_date is null;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DUP-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 :GLOBAL.disp_bags := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.disp_tubes := 'Y';
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 batch_id is null;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.disp_bags := 'N';
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from temp_units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.disp_tubes := 'N';
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :GLOBAL.field_left := :system.cursor_field;
 :GLOBAL.all_units_ok := 'Y';
 :system.message_level := 5;
 break;
 if :GLOBAL.disp_tubes = 'N' and :GLOBAL.disp_bags = 'N'
 then
 show_error('0152');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :GLOBAL.disp_tubes = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('temp_units');
 execute_query(FOR_UPDATE,NO_WAIT);
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.disp_bags = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('units_1');
 execute_query(FOR_UPDATE,NO_WAIT);
 end if;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.disp_tubes = 'N'
 then
 go_block('units_1');
 else
 go_block('temp_units');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;
